newsitem.title: FINLAND: Boy named Finnish "milkgirl" to boost product.
newsitem.headline: Boy named Finnish "milkgirl" to boost product.

text.p: A Finnish dairy association has broken an almost a quarter-century tradition by choosing a boy as its annual "milkgirl" to promote milk.

Pekka Yli-Piipari, 22, "a blonde, blue-eyed Viking who charmed the jury with his cheerfulness", was the first man to be chosen in 23 years of campaigning, the Milk and Health Association said in a statement.
A spokeswoman said the association wanted to highlight the sporting and health benefits of drinking fresh milk, citing statistics showing Finnish men drink more of it than women.
